spec.title: Execution
spec.description: Did the test finish? The exit code comes from the test report.

spec.title: Correctness
spec.description: Did the recorded content and access checks pass? Missing checks remain unverified.

spec.title: Cleanup
spec.description: Was the test data removed and its removal checked? Retained means the data was kept.

spec.title: Performance
spec.description: Regression checks a fixed load against any configured limit. Capacity reports the tested bound; a lower bound does not establish maximum capacity.

spec.title: Data uploaded
spec.description: Total file content uploaded successfully, excluding HTTP overhead.

spec.title: Worst final upload p95
spec.description: Highest final p95 reported across all attempts in this run. For each attempt, 95% of measured requests took this long or less. Read the failure count alongside latency.

spec.title: Failed uploads
spec.description: Zero is shown only when every attempt in this run records 100% successful uploads. Otherwise the failure count is unavailable.

spec.title: Tested upload points
spec.description: Each row is one test attempt. Inspect opens its workload and time range. Repeated load levels remain separate attempts.

spec.title: Tested activity levels
spec.description: Each row is one test attempt. Inspect opens its workload and time range. Repeated load levels remain separate attempts.

spec.title: Tested recipient batches
spec.description: Each row is one test attempt. Inspect opens its workload and time range. Repeated load levels remain separate attempts.

spec.title: Average upload rate by worker count
spec.description: Successful uploads divided by the full attempt duration, including setup, content checks and cleanup. Use Workload for the upload request rate over time.

properties.value: Average upload rate by worker count

spec.title: Final upload p95 by worker count
spec.description: Final p95 for each attempt at its worker count. Confirmation repeats a load; it is not an additional capacity level.

properties.value: Final upload p95 by worker count

spec.title: Upload success rate by activity level
spec.description: Share of successful uploads at each activity level. A level combines writer and reader roles using one identity.

properties.value: Upload success rate by activity level

spec.title: Final upload p95 by activity level
spec.description: Final upload p95 at each activity level. A level combines writer and reader roles using one identity.

properties.value: Final upload p95 by activity level

spec.title: Time to add and verify recipients
spec.description: Time to add each recipient batch and complete its recorded checks. Read the access, content and cleanup results alongside the duration.

properties.value: Time to add and verify recipients

spec.title: Time to revoke access
spec.description: Time to remove each recipient batch and complete its recorded checks. Read the removal result alongside the duration.

spec.title: Successful uploads per second
spec.description: Successful uploads per second, averaged over the query interval and limited to each recorded attempt. Older reports without attempt times show only fresh samples.

spec.expr: sum((rate(k6_http_reqs_total{campaignid="$run",load_target="$env",mode="$mode",executionid=~"$execution",operation="file-upload",status="201"}[$__rate_interval]) and on(executionid) ((cozy_load_point_value{load_target="$env",mode="$mode",run="$run",index=~"$point_index",metric="started_at_seconds"} @ $report_at <= time()) and on(run,index) (cozy_load_point_value{load_target="$env",mode="$mode",run="$run",index=~"$point_index",metric="ended_at_seconds"} @ $report_at >= time()))) or ((rate(k6_http_reqs_total{campaignid="$run",load_target="$env",mode="$mode",executionid=~"$execution",operation="file-upload",status="201"}[$__rate_interval]) and (timestamp(k6_http_reqs_total{campaignid="$run",load_target="$env",mode="$mode",executionid=~"$execution",operation="file-upload",status="201"}) > time() - 5)) unless on(executionid) cozy_load_point_value{load_target="$env",mode="$mode",run="$run",index=~"$point_index",metric="ended_at_seconds"} @ $report_at))

spec.title: Configured upload workers
spec.description: Configured workers for each recorded attempt. When attempt times are missing, the line uses saved k6 sample windows (5 s); very short attempts may have no samples.

spec.title: Upload latency
spec.description: Blue: p50. Cyan: p95. Amber: p99. Each value comes from a single attempt; simultaneous values are left blank. Percentiles are never averaged. The red line is the configured p95 limit. Successful uploads only.

spec.title: Upload success rate by tested level
Changes success rate by tested level
WebSocket handshake and auth rate by tested level
WebSocket: file-created notifications received per second
spec.description: CREATED events received by all WebSocket readers, per second. If every reader gets every event, this equals uploads per second times the number of WebSocket readers at that level. Grouped by the ramp level the file was uploaded at, read from its name, so a notification that arrives after its level ended still counts for that level. "unattributed" is for files uploaded during a transition between levels.

spec.title: Changes feed: new files received per second
spec.description: New files found by all changes-feed readers (GET /sharings/drives/:id/_changes), per second. If every reader gets every file, this equals uploads per second times the number of changes readers at that level. Grouped by the ramp level the file was uploaded at, read from its name, so a notification that arrives after its level ended still counts for that level. "unattributed" is for files uploaded during a transition between levels.

Changes pending p95 by tested level

spec.description: Owner readiness and successful recipient access checks are separate. Pending recipients have not passed the access check.

options.content:
**Local Prometheus · every 5 s**

Stack process metrics and local dependencies. Process CPU is measured in cores. Missing samples are unavailable.

spec.expr: sum by (method, code) (rate(http_all_total_duration_sum{job="$stackjob"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (method, code) (rate(http_all_total_duration_count{job="$stackjob"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Stack HTTP error rate
spec.description: Share of Stack requests that returned an HTTP error during the selected time range.

options.content:
**DEV InfluxDB · every 60 s**

Includes activity from all organizations on the selected hosts. Short spikes may fall between samples. HTTP p99 is shown per host. S3 and RabbitMQ metrics are unavailable. Heap, Redis blocked-client and HAProxy queue measurements are also unavailable from this datasource mapping.

spec.title: Latest Stack sample (UTC)
spec.description: Last DEV source sample within the selected window. Compare with the run end; this is not a guarantee that every metric is fresh.

spec.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.env == "dev" and r._measurement == "http_all_total_duration" and r._field == "count" and r.host =~ /^${stack:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["host"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: float(v: int(v: r._time)) / 1000000.0, host: r.host}))

spec.title: Requests/s by host
spec.description: Shared DEV activity, collected once a minute: background conditions for a run, not test-organization usage.

spec.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.env == "dev" and r._measurement == "http_all_total_duration" and r._field == "count" and r.host =~ /^${stack:regex}$/)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["host", "_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["host"])

spec.title: Mean job duration by worker type
spec.description: Interval duration over interval job count, per window. Shared DEV activity, collected once a minute: background conditions for a run, not test-organization usage.

spec.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.env == "dev" and r._measurement == "workers_exec_durations" and (r._field == "sum" or r._field == "count") and r.host =~ /^${stack:regex}$/ and r.worker_type =~ /^${worker_type:regex}$/)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["worker_type", "_field", "_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["worker_type", "_time"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.count and exists r.sum and r.count > 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, worker_type: r.worker_type, _value: r.sum / r.count}))
  |> group(columns: ["worker_type"])

  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["host", "_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["host"])

spec.title: Run time range
spec.description: Run + context clears the point selection and shows the full run with 1 minute before and after. Run only removes that margin. Use one after changing runs; the dropdown does not reset time.

spec.title: Choose a point
spec.description: Choose an attempt and its time range. Point + context adds 30 seconds before and 1 minute after. Point only shows the exact attempt. Use Run + context above to return to all points.

spec.title: Upload phases
spec.description: Recorded phases from attempt times. Reports without attempt times use saved k6 sample windows (5 s); very short attempts may have no samples.

spec.expr: max by (phase) (((cozy_load_point_value{load_target="$env",mode="$mode",run="$run",index=~"$point_index",metric="load"} @ $report_at and on(run,index) ((cozy_load_point_value{load_target="$env",mode="$mode",run="$run",index=~"$point_index",metric="started_at_seconds"} @ $report_at <= time()) and on(run,index) (cozy_load_point_value{load_target="$env",mode="$mode",run="$run",index=~"$point_index",metric="ended_at_seconds"} @ $report_at >= time()))) or ((cozy_load_point_value{load_target="$env",mode="$mode",run="$run",index=~"$point_index",metric="load"} @ $report_at and on(executionid) ((k6_vus{campaignid="$run",load_target="$env",mode="$mode",executionid=~"$execution"} > 0) and (timestamp(k6_vus{campaignid="$run",load_target="$env",mode="$mode",executionid=~"$execution"}) > time() - 5))) unless on(executionid) cozy_load_point_value{load_target="$env",mode="$mode",run="$run",index=~"$point_index",metric="ended_at_seconds"} @ $report_at)) > bool 0)

spec.title: Uploads completed
spec.description: Completed uploads across the selected activity levels. Missing counts remain unavailable.

spec.expr: sum(cozy_load_point_value{load_target="$env",mode="$mode",run="$run",metric="completed_uploads"} and on(run,index) cozy_load_point_evidence_info{load_target="$env",mode="$mode",run="$run",kind="shared_drive",status!~"not_run|not_measured|missing_result"}) and on() (count(cozy_load_point_value{load_target="$env",mode="$mode",run="$run",metric="completed_uploads"} and on(run,index) cozy_load_point_evidence_info{load_target="$env",mode="$mode",run="$run",kind="shared_drive",status!~"not_run|not_measured|missing_result"}) == count(cozy_load_point_evidence_info{load_target="$env",mode="$mode",run="$run",kind="shared_drive",status!~"not_run|not_measured|missing_result"}))

spec.title: Peak activity level
spec.description: Each activity level scales writer, WebSocket and changes-feed roles using one identity.

spec.title: Delivery · last selected level
spec.description: Observed notifications per expected notification at the last selected level. Delivery is separate from file-content verification.

spec.expr: max(cozy_load_point_value{load_target="$env",mode="$mode",run="$run",index=~"$point_index",kind="shared_drive",metric="upload_p95_ms"} and on(run,index) cozy_load_point_evidence_info{load_target="$env",mode="$mode",run="$run",point_id=~"$point",kind="shared_drive",status!~"not_run|not_measured|missing_result"}) and on() (count(cozy_load_point_value{load_target="$env",mode="$mode",run="$run",index=~"$point_index",kind="shared_drive",metric="upload_p95_ms"} and on(run,index) cozy_load_point_evidence_info{load_target="$env",mode="$mode",run="$run",point_id=~"$point",kind="shared_drive",status!~"not_run|not_measured|missing_result"}) == count(cozy_load_point_evidence_info{load_target="$env",mode="$mode",run="$run",point_id=~"$point",kind="shared_drive",status!~"not_run|not_measured|missing_result"}))

spec.title: Largest selected batch
spec.description: Largest recipient count among the selected batches.

spec.title: Access verified · last batch
spec.description: Recipient-side checks for the last selected batch. Owner-side status alone does not verify access or revocation.

spec.title: Revocation verified · last batch
spec.description: Recipient-side checks for the last selected batch. Owner-side status alone does not verify access or revocation.

spec.title: Tested batches
spec.description: Number of recorded batches among the selected points.

options.content:
**Download evidence** in **Run time range** saves the results shown here as JSON. Keep the original test report for the full details.

Workload metrics: runner Prometheus, every 1 s. DEV infrastructure: optional InfluxDB, every 60 s, across shared hosts. Missing data is shown as unavailable.

spec.title: Selected time range is outside this run or point
spec.description: The results are available, but the selected time range does not overlap the run or point. Click below to show the full run.

defaults.displayName: Click to show the run with 1 min before and after

links.title: Open the selected run and its recorded window

options.content:
**Not recorded in these reports.**

The tables show the final access and revocation checks for each batch. They do not record how the recipient counts changed over time.

spec.title: Workflows completed
spec.description: Workflows completed at every tested rate. Each workflow lists a fixture directory, reads and checks a fixture file and uploads 1 KiB.

spec.title: Highest tested rate
spec.description: The highest rate the search started; the Performance verdict gives the highest one that passed.

spec.title: Worst p95 · highest passing rate
spec.description: The slowest operation's p95 at the highest rate that passed.

spec.title: Dropped workflows
spec.description: Arrivals k6 could not start because every VU was busy, at every tested rate.

spec.title: Tested rates
spec.description: Each row is one rate of the search, one k6 run. Inspect opens its workload and time range.

spec.title: Achieved rate by tested rate
spec.description: Workflows k6 started per second at each tested rate, against the offered rate. A gap means dropped arrivals.

spec.title: p95 by tested rate
spec.description: Each operation's p95 at each tested rate, against the run's p95 limit. Any operation over it fails the rate.

spec.expr: label_replace(cozy_load_point_value{load_target="$env",mode="$mode",run="$run",kind="mixed",metric=~"(list|metadata|upload)_p95_ms"} * on(run,index) group_left(evidence) cozy_load_point_evidence_info{load_target="$env",mode="$mode",run="$run"}, "metric", "$1", "metric", "(list|metadata|upload)_p95_ms") or label_replace(label_replace((cozy_load_point_value{load_target="$env",mode="$mode",run="$run",kind="mixed",metric="load"} * 0 + on(run) group_left() cozy_load_result_value{load_target="$env",mode="$mode",run="$run",metric="p95_limit_ms"}), "metric", "p95 limit", "metric", ".*"), "evidence", "Criterion", "metric", ".*")

spec.title: Requests per second by operation
spec.description: Requests per second each operation sent, over the rates' k6 runs. Each workflow sends one of each.

spec.title: p95 by operation
spec.description: Each operation's p95 as k6 reports it during the rates' runs.
